The prior 128-thread candidate was slightly faster than baseline in search, but that does not establish that smaller blocks will help; added scheduling overhead or fewer warps per CTA could instead hurt.

No per-size breakdown or independent confirmation is available. The controller must validate every supported size before comparing this candidate's timings.
